Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG Opinion No. 22 S. 2011 03 June 2011 Ms. Marilyn V. Talosig Cabatuan, Isabela marilyntalosig(@yahoo.com Dear Ms. Talosig, This pertains to your e-mail communication sent to this Department requesting for an investigation on the alleged abuses of traffic enforcers in your municipality who were supposedly given authority by the Mayor to apprehend traffic violators and confiscate licenses. Per your letter, in a radio interview conducted by Bombo Radyo, the Mayor confirmed that he has given officials under his supervision as well as officers of the local police the power to apprehend traffic violators and confiscate driver's licenses. In reply thereto, please be informed that based on law and relevant jurisprudence, only the officers of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) and other government officers deputized by the LTO have the authority to confiscate driver's licenses of traffic violators. Hence, it is not correct for the Municipal Mayor to claim that his office has the power to authorize officials under his supervision to confiscate driver's licenses. However, we regret to inform you that this Department is not in a position to comply with your request for investigation of the alleged abuses committed by the officials concerned. Please be advised that the appropriate remedy for you is to institute an administrative case with either the Sangguniang Panlalawigan having jurisdiction over the Mayor or with the Office of the Ombudsman by filing a written complaint under oath accompanied by affidavits of witnesses and other evidence in support of your charge. We hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. AT Legal: 03 Very truly yours, . JESU B. DO UE Director 111
